name: activity-table
title: Activity table
description: A full data table page: search, status filter, sorting, row selection with bulk actions, CSV export, density, pagination, empty and loading states.
docs: Render <ActivityTable /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/activity-table/activity-table.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.
